name: dung
title: Abstract argumentation: grounded, preferred and stable semantics

reference.cite: Dung 1995, On the acceptability of arguments and its fundamental role in nonmonotonic reasoning, logic programming and n-person games

assumptions.text: Attacks are binary and equally strong; weights and probabilities are ignored.
Arguments are claims and evidential readings (links). An undercut makes the defeater attack the reading; a contradict reading attacks its claim; mutually exclusive claims attack each other.
For preferred and stable, a label is in (out) only when it is in (out) in every extension; otherwise undecided.

cost.class: grounded P; stable NP-complete; sceptical preferred Pi2P-complete

engine.impl: condorcet-dung (fixpoint; SAT labellings over rustsat + batsat)
